description: Generate a usage agreement document for a set of approved PixelVault assets. Call this after the human has approved a shortlist. Provide project details and approved asset IDs. Returns a completed usage agreement covering all approved assets in one document. The human must review and sign. Payment and final delivery happen at pixelvault-ui.vercel.app.

air_date.description: Anticipated air or publication date (YYYY-MM-DD or approximate).

asset_ids.description: List of approved asset IDs from the shortlist.

distribution_platform.description: Distribution platform(s) — e.g., "Netflix, Broadcast", "Editorial Web", "Instagram, Meta Ads".

name: generate_usage_agreement
